newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France head met U.S officials on link-up talks.
newsitem.headline: Air France head met U.S officials on link-up talks.

text.p: Air France chairman Christian Blanc met U.S. Transportation Secretary Federico Pena on Thursday to update him on the airline's talks with U.S. companies with which it seeks a transatlantic alliance.

Blanc met Pena and Assistant State Secretary Charles Hunnicut for a briefing on "current negotiations between Air France and certain American airlines," Air France said in a statement on Friday. An Air France official declined to name the U.S. airlines.
Air France has said it is talking to American Airlines (AMR Corp), United Airlines (UAL Corp), Delta Air Lines Inc and Continental Airlines.
